problem: During DWG block delivery, the parser retained BLOCK_HEADER preview bytes in DRW_Block_Record but omitted them from the corresponding DRW_Block callback used by LibreCAD. The tracked AC1024 title drawing produced 2088 record bytes and zero block bytes.
authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 section 20.4.52 places the binary preview data in BLOCK_HEADER and associates it with the block record.
implementation: Copy the parsed BLOCK_HEADER preview into DRW_Block before either callback path. If copying the path or preview throws, record the block failure and quarantine its owned frames before publishing a partial block; normal reader failure handling remains in force.
validation: The tracked tests/samples/AC1024/title_block-iso.dwg fixture now delivers the exact 2088-byte BLOCK_HEADER preview in the matching Title_Block-ISO block callback.

The focused test injects failures into all eight allocations of the 2088-byte size observed while reading the fixture, refuses any delivered block with a missing/different preview, and verifies a clean read immediately after every failure.
Three focused block/XRECORD/SORTENTSTABLE CTests pass; the LibreCAD_3 compatibility compile target also builds.

Source-release inventory passes with 1227 files and 18 refusal controls. Hosted-profile CTest inventory increases from 1377 to 1378 with exactly this test; the 725-input implementation digest is d2fbf3b7e98738e05bc8f6a097b74ee429b43f58bcc8988a7bc92e6554a539c7.
limits: The fixture proves callback consistency for one existing AC1024 drawing, not a native preview-rendering or whole-drawing export claim. Consumer import, richer metadata and platform qualification remain separate; no drawing fixture was added.
